frozenReceiptControls.positiveControl: Exact metadata retains documentary match and proof not-run. An imported matching receipt can pass schema/association validation only as test data; it never supplies local execution.
frozenReceiptControls.withheldControl: Skeptic freezes one additional payload independently before any implementation, with only its hash disclosed to the producer until acceptance testing.

proofOriginPolicy: Origin is an immutable event attribute. Relabeling, copying, rehashing or schema validation of an imported receipt cannot establish local observation. A separately executed checker event is required and remains independently scoped.
